templates.name: Support Concierge
templates.description: Tier-1 customer support agent that resolves common questions, escalates complex issues, and updates ticket systems.

templates.name: Onboarding Guide
templates.description: Walks new users through product setup, answers getting-started questions, and schedules follow-ups.

templates.name: Refund Specialist
templates.description: Handles refund requests with policy compliance. Verifies orders, processes refunds, and notifies customers.

templates.name: Knowledge Curator
templates.description: Auto-curates help articles from support conversations. Identifies knowledge gaps and drafts new content.

templates.name: Sales Researcher
templates.description: Researches prospects before calls, summarizes recent news, funding, and tech stack. Preps the rep with context.

templates.name: Lead Qualifier
templates.description: Engages inbound leads, asks discovery questions, and books meetings for AEs when qualified.

templates.name: Quote Builder
templates.description: Generates accurate quotes based on customer needs, applies discounts, and produces PDF proposals.

templates.name: Market Analyst
templates.description: Synthesizes industry reports, earnings calls, and news into briefings for your team.

templates.name: Competitive Intel
templates.description: Monitors competitor activity — pricing changes, new features, hiring — and alerts your team weekly.

templates.name: Internal Helpdesk
templates.description: Answers IT questions, resets passwords, provisions access. Routes complex tickets to the right team.

templates.name: DevOps Assistant
templates.description: Triages incidents, summarizes logs, and posts status updates during outages.

templates.name: Data Analyst
templates.description: Answers business questions in plain English by querying your warehouse and returning tables + charts.
